parameters.query: SET @portfolio_review_locked = NULL; SELECT ticket_id INTO @portfolio_review_locked FROM ai_support_portfolio.tickets WHERE ticket_id = SUBSTRING($1,2) FOR UPDATE; UPDATE ai_support_portfolio.tickets SET processing_status = SUBSTRING($2,2), classification_category = SUBSTRING($3,2), classification_reason = SUBSTRING($4,2), requires_review = 0, review_reason = NULL WHERE ticket_id = SUBSTRING($5,2) AND processing_status = 'PENDING_REVIEW' AND requires_review = 1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ai_support_portfolio.ticket_audit WHERE ticket_id = SUBSTRING($6,2) AND event_key = 'HUMAN_REVIEW_DECISION:v1'); SET @portfolio_review_updated = ROW_COUNT(); INSERT INTO ai_support_portfolio.ticket_audit (ticket_id,event_key,event_type,previous_status,new_status,reviewer_id,execution_id,details) SELECT ticket_id,'HUMAN_REVIEW_DECISION:v1','HUMAN_REVIEW_DECIDED','PENDING_REVIEW', processing_status,SUBSTRING($7,2),SUBSTRING($8,2), JSON_OBJECT('decisionId',SUBSTRING($9,2),'decision',SUBSTRING($10,2), 'category',SUBSTRING($11,2),'reason',SUBSTRING($12,2)) FROM ai_support_portfolio.tickets WHERE ticket_id = SUBSTRING($13,2) AND @portfolio_review_updated = 1; SET @portfolio_review_audited = ROW_COUNT(); SELECT t.ticket_id,t.processing_status,a.event_type,a.new_status,a.reviewer_id,a.details, @portfolio_review_updated AS updated_rows,@portfolio_review_audited AS audit_rows FROM (SELECT 1 AS anchor) seed LEFT JOIN ai_support_portfolio.tickets t ON t.ticket_id = SUBSTRING($14,2) LEFT JOIN ai_support_portfolio.ticket_audit a ON a.ticket_id = t.ticket_id AND a.event_key = 'HUMAN_REVIEW_DECISION:v1';
